title: Boku no Hero Academia: More
content:
I thought they were gonna pull off a Your Name on us at the end. Good thing Midoriya manned up. Can’t believe Himeko had to resurrect herself as a ghost in Ochako’s dream to make it happen.

Honestly, this special was so warm and comforting, to see all of the class all grown up and responsible, even though their personality remained intact, it makes me feel like the grown up that they are to those students. I think this was the perfect note to leave these characters on.

Although I would have to admit, that last hero call was over blown lol, those scoundrels had no idea what was about to pursue them.

Overall: 8.06/10.
